topic: How does antenna design influence the accuracy of encrypted traffic classification systems in heterogeneous satellite networks?
consensus_response: Antenna design affects signal integrity, introducing distortions and interference that degrade encrypted traffic classification accuracy. Adaptive beamforming optimizes patterns to minimize interference, improving signal integrity and classification performance. Satellite geometry and Doppler shift also impact signal propagation and processing.
reference_context: Polarization correlation coefficients and operating frequencies influence signal characteristics, with values like 0.4-0.5 and 2.2GHz impacting performance.
